##[group]Run for attempt in 1 2 3; do
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "${CI_BASE_SHA}"; then
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "git fetch of the base commit failed (attempt ${attempt}/3)" >&2
  # No sleep after the final attempt — there is no fourth.
  if [ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]; then
    sleep $(( attempt * 5 ))
  fi
done
